title: Outward-walk counter coordinate
statement: For an exponential breadth-first-search state $S$, the coordinate at index $10$ of its 17-entry counter vector is its outward-walk counter $T$; that is, this coordinate equals $S.T$.
replaced:
For every state $S$ of the exponential breadth-first search procedure, the
outward-walk-counter coordinate of its 17-entry register vector is $S.T$.
